body: Builds on T-128, which made every event store ref:"<branch>@<hash>" (HEAD at event time). Field report: this is "the single most valuable under-documented feature" — closing a ticket right after committing a fix stamps the close event with the fix commit, no manual SHA-in-note needed. But the ref is currently only visible via `-f json`; `show -a` and `log` do not print it. Asks: (a) surface the short hash in the text views, e.g. `[22:55] closed (04bb189) owner:`; (b) document the ordering contract explicitly in SKILL.md/README — commit the fix FIRST, then close, so ref captures the fix commit and not the pre-fix HEAD.
title: surface event ref (commit hash) in text views and document commit-then-close ordering
